title: Fresh-context Agent Reproducibility with Machine-audited Null Provenance

execution_contract.runner: one `claude -p` process per (suite, run) in an isolated working directory
execution_contract.model: claude opus (CLI alias `opus`), CLI-authenticated, no provider API key in the environment
execution_contract.contract_repair: bounded validation-feedback retries in the same context; feedback never contains truth

prompt_policy: P1 is the single frozen prompt for every run; no structure-specific vocabulary was added relative to v0.3.7 P1. New sections cover only lineage bindingness and null provenance mechanics.
assignment: suite-rotated balanced rotation over S0/S1/S2 with the prompt arm fixed to P1

lineage_continuity.enforced_by: controller validation of selected_lineage_id sequences before lock
lineage_continuity.rule: under posterior_commit or two_hit_maturation an open lineage must be re-selected next cycle unless explicitly closed, falsified, or matured

null_provenance.uniqueness_audit: permutation/feature/model/OOF hashes must be unique across replicates within a pack
null_provenance.limitation: artifacts are agent-computed and structurally audited; independent re-execution is future work

calibration.c1: isotonic map fit on development suites only, applied to qualification p_structure_exists as a secondary metric
calibration.c2: development-ECE-selected evidence gate recorded per agent; primary gates remain the raw v0.3.7 gates for comparability

hidden_regions.structure_confirmation: may affect discovery adjudication but never translation selection
hidden_regions.transfer_sealed: transfer evaluation only and never discovery promotion

isolation.level: working-directory isolation outside the repository, CLI deny rules against repository and controller paths, encrypted truth at rest, post-hoc transcript audit
isolation.note: container/mount isolation remains deferred; this run must not be described as container-isolated

generator_policy: v0.3.7 families, ladder, and pack design unchanged with new master seeds, so the intervention set is the only difference against the v0.3.7 baseline
